profiles.name: Nihal A.
profiles.head: Client Partner, Virtusa (Manufacturing & Retail)
strengths: Has done services business development across four firms: Bahwan CyberTek enterprise accounts, HCLTech BFSI BD, Movate and now Virtusa client partner
Sells to C-suite buyers; based in Chennai and fits the 8-15 year band
gaps: His Virtusa client partner role is recent, so his own new-logo results are not yet proven
No testing (QE) or GCC focus shown
profiles.next: Phone screen: the logos he won personally at HCLTech and Bahwan, and his US exposure

profiles.name: Apoorva Shree M
profiles.head: Manager - New Business & Client Engagement, Test Yantra
strengths: Sells testing as a service as a new-business hunter for India's largest testing services firm
Has anchored deals and runs a testing CoE-led solution approach
gaps: Test Yantra's clients are mostly Indian and mid-market, so she lacks GCC or US enterprise experience
profiles.next: Strong QE fit; check total years and largest deal won

profiles.name: Ramachandran R
profiles.head: Strategic Sales Development Executive, Virtusa (ex-Account Manager BFS, Wipro)
strengths: Was an account manager at Wipro for BFS, running the full sales cycle with CIO/CTO buyers
Did earlier BD at Virtusa with Fortune 100 banks in Canada and Europe
gaps: His current title is sales development, which is below a client partner
Background is BFSI only, with no testing (QE)
profiles.next: Find out whether he carries a quota and his biggest close at Wipro
